summary: G010 T004 delivered: reproduced the suppressed-profile-cannot-rerun behavior as a permanent regression pin, then closed the G009 T008 gap by consuming the existing G009 T007 permission-config fingerprint. When a suppression engages, run_slice records the blocking-time effective config fingerprint (suppression_baseline task event, once per blocker episode); the new `orx task reverify <task> --profile <name> --reason <what changed>` re-reads the current effective fingerprint (read-only preflight) and lifts the exclusion for exactly that (task, profile) only on a genuinely different fingerprint (suppression_reopen event with both fingerprints, sources, operator restart reason, attempt watermark). Bounded by construction: same effective fingerprint, mtime-only touch (honestly flagged), repeated reverify, repeated retry, and an already-reopened-and-failed config all refuse (recorded suppression_reverify_refused events); the lift is one-shot (consumed by the profile's next attempt; a returning same-condition blocker re-engages the bounded suppression from the recorded streak); a missing blocking-time fingerprint records a supplementary baseline plus explicit steps and never lifts on an unverifiable claim; host/shell harnesses get routing-shaped steps. Original semantics preserved: failure classification/blocker fingerprints/streaks untouched, quota and quota-domain gates independent of the lift (an exhausted lifted profile stops with the exhaustion reason), recovery identity rules untouched (reverify starts no worker, creates no attempt/nonce; the restart is the next orx run's normal dispatch), and the Goal lifecycle startup gate refuses reverify while paused/cancelling/cancelled before any write. Zero schema change (three append-only task-event kinds, JSON payloads in the reason column). New tests: 10 (9 red-first new-behavior tests + 1 reproduction pin), full suite 1125 passed 0 failures. User's uncommitted docs/m1.2-report.md untouched (sha matches the T001 postscript record), left unstaged and out of the task commit 924d7f1.
